articles.author: KNOREX LTD.
articles.headline: Form EFFECT KNOREX LTD. - Notice of Effectiveness
articles.summary: The published notice identifies Knorex's Form F-1 registration statement 333-299038 as effective September 25. The notice was distributed September 28. Effectiveness permits registered securities activity under the filing; it is not confirmation that an offering sold or new funding was received.
articles.timestampEvidence: Opened StreetInsider notice explicitly gives September 28, 2026 6:06 AM EDT and CIK 1982960. Indexed PublicNow independently records distribution via EDGAR September 28 at 10:06 UTC. The September 25 legal effectiveness date is not used as publication.
